assertion.statement: The reduced image X of the actual homomorphism of characteristic-zero abelian varieties is smooth over the same field after the local argument makes it a finite-type group scheme.
assertion.objects: The reduced closed image X in D of the actual homomorphism A to D over k.
assertion.hypotheses: k has characteristic zero; A and D are abelian varieties; the preceding schematic-dominance argument constructs multiplication, inversion and identity on the finite-type image X.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such actual homomorphism over the original field k.
assertion.uniformity: Same field and same reduced image; no field extension or replacement object.
assertion.normalizations: Reduced closed image with induced group law.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No assertion that arbitrary nonreduced finite-type groups in positive characteristic are smooth.
assertion.limit_order: Construct X as a finite-type group scheme before invoking smoothness; geometric connectedness and projectivity are proved separately.

use.reason: Actual Cartier smoothness input in the abelian-image proof, before the rational-idempotent conclusions.
